documentation_source.label: Gmail API v1 (OpenAPI rendering of the discovery document, trimmed)
Slack Web API OpenAPI (trimmed local mirror)
HubSpot CRM contacts reference (documentation prose, no OpenAPI seeded)
GitHub REST API (trimmed local mirror of the official OpenAPI description)
Twilio Programmable Messaging (trimmed local mirror). credential_env_var must hold base64(AccountSid:AuthToken) — Basic auth here is pre-encoded, not a raw token.
Discord API (trimmed local mirror). credential_env_var must hold "Bot <token>" verbatim — the header auth scheme substitutes the env var value as-is.
Notion API (trimmed local mirror, fetched 2026-09 — uses the current data_sources query endpoint, not the deprecated databases/query one).
Asana API reference (documentation prose — upstream OpenAPI source is YAML and this pipeline only parses JSON, so this provider ingests via the markdown path instead).
DocuSign eSignature API (trimmed local mirror, hand-converted from the upstream Swagger 2.0 document — this pipeline's OpenAPI parser expects 3.x request/response shapes).
Mailchimp Marketing API (trimmed local mirror, hand-converted from the upstream Swagger 2.0 document). credential_env_var must hold base64("anystring:<api_key>") — Basic auth here is pre-encoded.
PagerDuty REST API v2 (trimmed local mirror). credential_env_var must hold "Token token=<key>" verbatim — the header auth scheme substitutes the env var value as-is.

capabilities.name: create_checkout_session
capabilities.description: Creates a Checkout Session, a hosted payment page that collects a payment for a set of line items and returns a checkout URL.

inputs.name: Idempotency-Key
inputs.description: Unique key that makes the request safe to retry.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: The mode of the Checkout Session.

inputs.name: line_items
inputs.description: Items the customer is purchasing.

inputs.name: price
inputs.description: ID of an existing Price object.

inputs.name: quantity
inputs.description: Quantity of the line item.

inputs.name: success_url
inputs.description: URL the customer is redirected to after payment succeeds.

inputs.name: cancel_url
inputs.description: URL the customer is redirected to if they cancel.

inputs.name: customer_email
inputs.description: Email address the receipt and prefilled form use.

inputs.name: client_reference_id
inputs.description: Opaque reference that ties the session to your own system.

outputs.name: id
outputs.description: Unique identifier of the Checkout Session.

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Hosted checkout page URL to send the customer to.

outputs.name: amount_total
outputs.description: Total of all items, in the smallest currency unit.

outputs.name: customer_email
outputs.description: Email address supplied for this session.

outputs.name: expires_at
outputs.description: Unix timestamp at which the session expires.

authentication.scheme_description: Stripe secret API key sent as a bearer token.

rate_limits.note: Documented live-mode default: 100 read/write ops per second.

side_effects.description: Creates a Checkout Session, a hosted payment page that collects a payment for a set of line items and returns a checkout URL.

capabilities.name: create_payment_link
capabilities.description: Creates a shareable payment link that collects a payment for a set of line items.

inputs.name: line_items
inputs.description: Items the payment link sells.

inputs.name: price
inputs.description: ID of an existing Price object.

inputs.name: quantity
inputs.description: Quantity of the line item.

inputs.name: after_completion
inputs.description: Behaviour after the customer completes the payment.

outputs.name: id
outputs.description: Unique identifier of the payment link.

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Public URL the customer opens to pay.

outputs.name: active
outputs.description: Whether the link can currently be paid.

authentication.scheme_description: Stripe secret API key sent as a bearer token.

rate_limits.note: Documented live-mode default: 100 read/write ops per second.

side_effects.description: Creates a shareable payment link that collects a payment for a set of line items.

capabilities.name: create_refund
capabilities.description: Refunds a charge that has previously been created, returning funds to the customer.

inputs.name: payment_intent
inputs.description: ID of the PaymentIntent to refund.

inputs.name: charge
inputs.description: ID of the charge to refund.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Amount to refund, in the smallest currency unit.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Reason for the refund.

outputs.name: amount
outputs.description: Amount refunded, in the smallest currency unit.

outputs.name: payment_intent
outputs.description: ID of the PaymentIntent that was refunded.

authentication.scheme_description: Stripe secret API key sent as a bearer token.

rate_limits.note: Documented live-mode default: 100 read/write ops per second.

side_effects.description: Refunds a charge that has previously been created, returning funds to the customer.

capabilities.name: get_payment_intent
capabilities.description: Retrieves the details of a PaymentIntent, including its current status.

inputs.name: payment_intent
inputs.description: Identifier of the PaymentIntent to retrieve.

outputs.name: amount
outputs.description: Amount intended to be collected, in the smallest currency unit.

outputs.name: customer
outputs.description: ID of the customer this PaymentIntent belongs to.

outputs.name: receipt_email
outputs.description: Email address the receipt was sent to.

outputs.name: latest_charge
outputs.description: ID of the most recent charge.

rate_limits.note: Documented live-mode default: 100 read/write ops per second.

side_effects.description: Retrieves the details of a PaymentIntent, including its current status.

capabilities.name: payment_intent_succeeded
capabilities.description: Occurs when a payment succeeds: the PaymentIntent has moved to the succeeded status and funds are captured.

outputs.name: created
outputs.description: Unix timestamp at which the event occurred.

outputs.name: amount
outputs.description: Amount intended to be collected, in the smallest currency unit.

outputs.name: customer
outputs.description: ID of the customer this PaymentIntent belongs to.

outputs.name: receipt_email
outputs.description: Email address the receipt was sent to.

outputs.name: latest_charge
outputs.description: ID of the most recent charge.

authentication.scheme_description: Delivered to a subscriber endpoint; verified by signature, not by our credential.

side_effects.description: Emitted by Stripe when payment_intent.succeeded occurs.

capabilities.name: checkout_session_completed
capabilities.description: Occurs when a customer completes a Checkout Session.

outputs.name: created
outputs.description: Unix timestamp at which the event occurred.

outputs.name: id
outputs.description: Unique identifier of the Checkout Session.

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Hosted checkout page URL to send the customer to.

outputs.name: amount_total
outputs.description: Total of all items, in the smallest currency unit.

outputs.name: customer_email
outputs.description: Email address supplied for this session.

outputs.name: expires_at
outputs.description: Unix timestamp at which the session expires.

authentication.scheme_description: Delivered to a subscriber endpoint; verified by signature, not by our credential.

side_effects.description: Emitted by Stripe when checkout.session.completed occurs.

capabilities.name: send_message
capabilities.description: Sends an email message to the recipients listed in the encoded message headers.

inputs.name: userId
inputs.description: The user's email address, or the special value `me` for the authenticated user.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.description: The entire RFC 2822 email message — To, Subject and body included — base64url encoded.

inputs.name: threadId
inputs.description: ID of the thread the message belongs to.

outputs.name: threadId
outputs.description: ID of the thread the message belongs to.

authentication.scheme_description: Google OAuth 2.0 access token with the listed Gmail scopes.

rate_limits.note: Documented per-user quota, in quota units per second.

side_effects.description: Sends an email message to the recipients listed in the encoded message headers.

capabilities.name: get_message
capabilities.description: Gets a single email message, including its headers and body snippet.

inputs.name: userId
inputs.description: The user's email address, or `me`.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: The ID of the message to retrieve.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: How much of the message to return: minimal, full, raw or metadata.

outputs.name: threadId
outputs.description: ID of the thread the message belongs to.

outputs.name: snippet
outputs.description: Short part of the message text.

outputs.name: internalDate
outputs.description: Epoch milliseconds at which the message was received.

outputs.name: mimeType
outputs.description: MIME type of the top-level part.

outputs.name: headers
outputs.description: Message headers such as From, To and Subject.

authentication.scheme_description: Google OAuth 2.0 access token with the listed Gmail scopes.

rate_limits.note: Documented per-user quota, in quota units per second.

side_effects.description: Gets a single email message, including its headers and body snippet.

capabilities.name: list_messages
capabilities.description: Lists and searches the email messages in the user's mailbox.

inputs.name: userId
inputs.description: The user's email address, or `me`.

inputs.name: q
inputs.description: Gmail search query, using the same syntax as the Gmail search box.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

outputs.name: messages
outputs.description: Matching messages, id and thread only.

outputs.name: threadId
outputs.description: ID of the thread the message belongs to.

outputs.name: nextPageToken
outputs.description: Token for the next page of results.

authentication.scheme_description: Google OAuth 2.0 access token with the listed Gmail scopes.

rate_limits.note: Documented per-user quota, in quota units per second.

side_effects.description: Lists and searches the email messages in the user's mailbox.

capabilities.name: create_draft
capabilities.description: Creates a draft email message with the supplied encoded content.

inputs.name: userId
inputs.description: The user's email address, or `me`.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: The draft message content.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.description: The entire RFC 2822 email message, base64url encoded.

outputs.name: threadId
outputs.description: ID of the thread the message belongs to.

authentication.scheme_description: Google OAuth 2.0 access token with the listed Gmail scopes.

rate_limits.note: Documented per-user quota, in quota units per second.

side_effects.description: Creates a draft email message with the supplied encoded content.

capabilities.name: chat_post_message
capabilities.description: Sends a message to a Slack channel, private group or direct message conversation.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.description: Channel, private group or user ID to post to. Channel names are also accepted.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The message text. Required unless blocks or attachments are supplied.

inputs.name: blocks
inputs.description: Structured Block Kit blocks making up the message.

inputs.name: thread_ts
inputs.description: Timestamp of the parent message, to post this message as a threaded reply.

inputs.name: unfurl_links
inputs.description: Whether to unfurl links in the message.

outputs.name: channel
outputs.description: ID of the channel the message landed in.

outputs.name: ts
outputs.description: Timestamp identifier of the posted message.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: The message as stored by Slack.

outputs.name: user
outputs.description: ID of the posting user or bot.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Error code when ok is false.

authentication.scheme_description: Slack bot or user OAuth token sent as a bearer token.

rate_limits.note: chat.postMessage is Tier-special: roughly 1 message per channel per second.

side_effects.description: Sends a message to a Slack channel, private group or direct message conversation.

capabilities.name: conversations_list
capabilities.description: Lists all channels and conversations in a Slack workspace, so a channel can be found by name.

inputs.name: types
inputs.description: Comma-separated conversation types: public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of conversations to return per page.

inputs.name: exclude_archived
inputs.description: Whether to exclude archived channels.

outputs.name: name
outputs.description: Channel name without the leading hash.

outputs.name: is_channel
outputs.description: Whether this is a public channel.

authentication.scheme_description: Slack bot or user OAuth token sent as a bearer token.

rate_limits.note: chat.postMessage is Tier-special: roughly 1 message per channel per second.

side_effects.description: Lists all channels and conversations in a Slack workspace, so a channel can be found by name.
